source_state: uncommitted native relative attention and multi-axis rotary bounds, coordinate fixes and prepared Inkling quote assertions
behavior: Relative-profile attention composes two integer coordinate/mask constructions, optional logarithmic query/bias scaling, direct profile gathering, GQA head expansion, dense products and precise softmax. Casts, strided reshape copies and all native child buffers remain in the completion envelope; no disjoint host numerical payload is constructed.

Multi-axis rotary bounds follow independent-axis, split-half and round-robin layouts. They include widened integer coordinates and scalars, selected columns, native frequency sources/copies, concatenation, angle construction and cosine/sine output storage. The disjoint host bound is the largest live exact-sized Rust frequency vector.

Signed I32 position offsets saturate using widened arithmetic, matching the neutral reference. U32 coordinates widen before offset arithmetic. Round-robin execution no longer constructs unused independent-axis graphs; section selection uses widened multiplication.
Relative attention accepts the final valid I32 span by shifting integer coordinates after arange. The same kernel serves contiguous and paged attention.

432 relative configurations cover four geometries, three coordinate origins including the final I32 span, causal/window policies, optional logarithmic scaling, F32/F16/BF16 and contiguous/strided inputs. Outputs match an independent F64 scalar host equation and active native allocation peaks fit cold bounds.

147 multi-axis configurations cover all three layouts, heterogeneous axis widths, multiple leading ranks, empty rows, I32/U32 positions, contiguous/strided inputs and signed saturation endpoints. Outputs match the neutral scalar reference, peaks fit cold bounds, and actual output backing capacities fit retained allowances.

CPU and Metal paged relative attention match scalar reference and contiguous execution through uneven cached spans. Initial and cached Inkling resident text equation quotes are now asserted bounded; DeepSeek and Muse fixtures retain explicit missing costs.

tolerances.relative_input_reference: actual native inputs converted to F32 after measurement, preserving input rounding

limits: This does not complete public request admission or full-family/path coverage. Grouped/hyper operators, selected addressable expert scheduling, materialization/transfers, paging, TP/PP, media, observation, speculation and independent copies still need complete prices or composition.
A bounded resident Inkling equation quote is not a complete request budget, released-checkpoint comparison, media quote or paged/distributed workspace bound.
Positional tensor bounds cover floating relative inputs and I32/U32 rotary positions represented by the metadata envelope. Other valid input domains remain explicitly unknown.

Native bounds cover active managed payload storage through completion, not allocator cache, native shape/command metadata, driver/JIT, total process or system memory. No new process-memory or released-checkpoint experiment was run.

Two cold tests occur in both suites, giving 45 unique tests. The workspace suite leaves 33 controlled allocator/native benchmarks ignored; the two new positional allocator benchmarks were explicitly run in the focused suite.
Initial compilation required correcting I64 scalar construction and a shadowed test helper. The recorded final commands passed after correction.
Existing large-unwind linker and unused internal quote/helper warnings remain; native runtime diagnostics are preserved in the logs.
